== English Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck comparison ==
The 2015 amendment moves “here” from after “vehicles” to after “characters.” The native announcement shows the old word struck through and the new one underlined. This ties the bonus to characters at Hutt Trade Route and excludes characters at a vehicle site of a vehicle at the Trade Route. The Dark Side text is unchanged. The archived Holotable and current publisher renditions carry the same replacement.
